No state is persisted and no error is raised, so the admin 'save' action silently does nothing — a real no-op introduced by this diff, though it may be an intentional placeholder for future embedding settings.

adjudication.rationale: Verified: `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` (new file) does not read params or mutate anything; it only `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)`, where `@embedding` is an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding`. On the client, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, which would hit the PUT `/admin/customize/embedding` route added in `config/routes.rb` and receive a 200 with re-rendered data but no persistence. However, the current `embedding.hbs` template does not invoke `saveChanges`, and host changes are persisted via `embeddable-host` saving to `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, so this is more an incomplete/unused endpoint than a user-visible broken flow in the shown diff.
